name: Trace Steps
job: Show a method as three to four linked steps, each a key and its mark, over the one stop line agreed before the work starts.

anatomy.role: Surface card with hairline border; a mono cyan key over its mark
Arrow between steps: right on wide screens, down on a phone
Dashed rule above, centred, secondary text with a bold lead

states.name: Phone width
states.note: Below 640px the steps stack and the arrows point down.

use_when: A short method the reader should hold in one glance, with a kill line agreed in advance.
A bridge between the problem and the offer: how one item will be read.
avoid_when: Do not use it for a timeline with dates; that is 46 Day List or 52 Plan Matrix.
Do not go past four steps; the arrows stop reading as one line. It replaces 06 Beat Stepper (legacy) for new pages.

data.note: The kill line, for example `Agreed first:` and the number that says stop.

access: Steps are an ordered list, so a screen reader announces the count and order; the arrows are generated content and are not read.
Wrap it in a `figure` with an `aria-label` naming the method.
Print hides it by default (the PDF states the method in prose); remove the print rule if your PDF needs it.

used_by.name: Louisville proposal (louisville.arcs.care/proposal), page-local today; swap in after the send

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it line for line.
`artifact_wrap_lint.py` and `page_gate.py` on every page that carries it; sweep 360 to 1440, including 700 to 1000.
